answer: Anchor every agent identity in a kernel of bonded, verified work: to earn voting weight an agent must complete distinct tasks attested by unrelated peers, with its stake slashed on fraud. A Sybil farmer planting a garden of fake identities pays the bond plus real work per head, and copied work histories are rejected by hash chaining, so each new plume of aliases costs as much as a genuine agent while earning nothing extra. Scale the bond quadratically and fakes become unprofitable.
